What we are considering, building and have decided

This board shows what our team is considering, what we are building, what is queued and in what order, and what we are not pursuing right now. It is drawn from our public GitHub issues and refreshed regularly.

Board last refreshed: 29 June 2026 at 13:02

About this board

Items appear only after a person on our team has reviewed them, so the board stays clear and useful. The further an item is from In progress, the less certain it is. Votes are a signal the team weighs up, not an automatic decision.

Voting needs a free GitHub account. Your vote is registered on GitHub, and each account counts once.

Not being considered right now

Things we have looked at and decided against for the time being, with a short reason.

  • Native mobile app

    Build a native iOS and Android app in addition to the website.

    Why this is not being pursued

    The website already works well on mobile browsers, so a native app would duplicate effort for little gain right now. We will revisit this if offline needs grow.

    • type: platform
    15You need a free GitHub account to add your support.

  • Integrate with a third-party booking widget

    Embed an external booking widget rather than building our own booking flow.

    Why this is not being pursued

    A third-party widget would send patient data to an external processor, which we cannot justify for this service. We will keep booking in-house.

    • type: integration
    4You need a free GitHub account to add your support.
